verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃ שְׁמַע־ אֱלֹהִ֣ים קוֹלִ֣י בְשִׂיחִ֑י תִּצֹּ֥ר חַיָּֽי׃ מִפַּ֥חַד א֝וֹיֵ֗ב
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ miz·mō·wr lə·ḏā·wiḏ šə·ma‘- ’ĕ·lō·hîm qō·w·lî ḇə·śî·ḥî tiṣ·ṣōr ḥay·yāy mip·pa·ḥaḏ ’ō·w·yêḇ
verses.literal: For the choirmaster A Psalm of David Hear O God my voice of complaint preserve my life from dread of the enemy

verses.original: תַּ֭סְתִּירֵנִי מִסּ֣וֹד מְרֵעִ֑ים מֵ֝רִגְשַׁ֗ת פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
verses.literal: Hide me from the scheming of the wicked from the mob of workers of iniquity

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר שָׁנְנ֣וּ לְשׁוֹנָ֑ם כַחֶ֣רֶב דָּרְכ֥וּ מָֽר׃ דָּבָ֥ר חִ֝צָּ֗ם
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer šā·nə·nū lə·šō·w·nām ḵa·ḥe·reḇ dā·rə·ḵū mār dā·ḇār ḥiṣ·ṣām
verses.literal: who sharpen their tongues like swords and aim their bitter words like arrows

verses.original: לִיר֣וֹת תָּ֑ם בַּמִּסְתָּרִ֣ים יֹ֝רֻ֗הוּ פִּתְאֹ֥ם וְלֹ֣א יִירָֽאוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lî·rō·wṯ tām bam·mis·tā·rîm yō·ru·hū piṯ·’ōm wə·lō yî·rā·’ū
verses.literal: ambushing the innocent in seclusion shooting suddenly without fear

verses.original: יְחַזְּקוּ־ לָ֨מוֹ׀ רָ֗ע דָּ֘בָ֤ר יְֽ֭סַפְּרוּ לִטְמ֣וֹן מוֹקְשִׁ֑ים מִ֣י יִרְאֶה־ לָּֽמוֹ׃ אָ֝מְר֗וּ
verses.transliteration: yə·ḥaz·zə·qū- lā·mōw rā‘ dā·ḇār yə·sap·pə·rū liṭ·mō·wn mō·wq·šîm mî yir·’eh- lā·mōw ’ā·mə·rū
verses.literal: They hold fast to their evil purpose they speak of hiding their snares Who will see them they say

verses.original: יַֽחְפְּֽשׂוּ־ עוֹלֹ֗ת תַּ֭מְנוּ חֵ֣פֶשׂ מְחֻפָּ֑שׂ וְקֶ֥רֶב אִ֝֗ישׁ וְלֵ֣ב עָמֹֽק׃
verses.transliteration: yaḥ·pə·śū- ‘ō·w·lōṯ tam·nū ḥê·p̄eś mə·ḥup·pāś wə·qe·reḇ ’îš wə·lêḇ ‘ā·mōq
verses.literal: They devise injustice [and say] We have perfected a secret plan For the inner man and the heart are mysterious

verses.original: אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים וַיֹּרֵ֗ם חֵ֥ץ פִּתְא֑וֹם הָ֝י֗וּ מַכּוֹתָֽם׃
verses.literal: But God will shoot them with arrows suddenly they will be wounded

verses.original: וַיַּכְשִׁיל֣וּהוּ לְשׁוֹנָ֑ם עָלֵ֣ימוֹ כָּל־ רֹ֥אֵה בָֽם׃ יִ֝תְנֹדֲד֗וּ
verses.transliteration: way·yaḵ·šî·lū·hū lə·šō·w·nām ‘ā·lê·mōw kāl- rō·’êh ḇām yiṯ·nō·ḏă·ḏū
verses.literal: They will be made to stumble their own tongues turned against them All who see will shake their heads

verses.original: כָּל־ אָ֫דָ֥ם וַיִּֽירְא֗וּ וַ֭יַּגִּידוּ פֹּ֥עַל אֱלֹהִ֗ים הִשְׂכִּֽילוּ׃ וּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֥הוּ
verses.transliteration: kāl- ’ā·ḏām way·yî·rə·’ū way·yag·gî·ḏū pō·‘al ’ĕ·lō·hîm hiś·kî·lū ū·ma·‘ă·śê·hū
verses.literal: Then all mankind will fear and proclaim the work of God so they will ponder what He has done

verses.original: צַדִּ֣יק יִשְׂמַ֬ח בַּ֭יהוָה וְחָ֣סָה ב֑וֹ כָּל־ יִשְׁרֵי־ לֵֽב׃ וְ֝יִתְהַֽלְל֗וּ
verses.transliteration: ṣad·dîq yiś·maḥ Yah·weh wə·ḥā·sāh ḇōw kāl- yiš·rê- lêḇ wə·yiṯ·hal·lū
verses.literal: Let the righteous rejoice in the LORD and take refuge in Him let all the upright in heart exult
